summary.text: A 32-year-old man with hypertension and a family history of psoriasis in both grandmothers presented to dermatology clinic with linear erythematous scaly plaques along the lines of Blaschko of the back, right arm and right thigh present for over 23 years, plus a discrete silver-scaled plaque on the left elbow, without joint pain or joint, scalp or nail involvement. He was a nonsmoker.

He was presumed to have ILVEN and was treated with excimer laser, topical steroids, methotrexate (mild improvement with recurrence), etanercept (no improvement), adalimumab (stopped after 3 months) and ustekinumab (no improvement); surgical excision and CO2 laser were followed by recurrence. A 2021 biopsy showed psoriasiform dermatitis, and Ki-67 staining was elevated, favoring Blaschkoid psoriasis (type II with concurrent psoriasis vulgaris) over ILVEN.

He then failed calcipotriene, tapinarof, deucravacitinib and apremilast with halobetasol; in October 2024 body surface area was 20% and Investigator’s Global Assessment 4. Bimekizumab 320 mg every 4 weeks for 16 weeks then every 8 weeks was started.

At week 10 erythema, scaling and plaque flattening were significantly improved with no adverse events (body surface area 15%, Investigator’s Global Assessment 3) with halobetasol continued on the knuckles. At 6 months improvement continued (body surface area 15%, Investigator’s Global Assessment 2), halobetasol was discontinued and the patient was pleased; the authors describe an attenuated response with partial clearance.

article_limitations: Introduction and discussion statements on Blaschkoid psoriasis, ILVEN, bimekizumab pharmacology and cited published cases are background and not copied to the patient.
Prior-therapy order and dates are not stated; the 2021 biopsy is the only dated event before the October 2024 visit.
Drug classes named in the discussion (TNF-alpha, IL-23, TYK2 inhibitors) are not mapped to specific drugs, and no pruritus, laboratory or imaging data are reported.
Fig 3 photographs show chest or trunk skin that the text does not list as a site; no site is added to the facts from pixels.
